name: TIC 141624016

text.card: A red giant 1,394 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.84 solar masses and 20.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,217 K at its surface.
